Opens at midnight on Thursdays!
📌Get Notifications: Sign up for [Myosikdang KakaoTalk notifications] to receive notifications when group purchases open! Kakao Talk Notifications https://pf.kakao.com/_jEvfn

🥣 [Ingredients]
4 carrots
1 onion
1 cup roasted cashews (paper cup size)
0.5 tablespoon minced garlic
3 tablespoons olive oil
A pinch of salt and pepper (adjust to taste)
Water (enough to completely submerge the ingredients, about 500-600 ml)

👩‍🍳 [Directions - Pot Version]
1. Cut the carrots and onions into bite-sized pieces.

2. Pour a generous amount of olive oil into a pot and sauté the carrots, onions, and garlic over medium heat.

3. When the ingredients are about 1/3 cooked, add enough water to cover them and simmer until fully cooked.

4. Let cool, then place in a blender and blend together 1 cup of cashews, salt, and pepper.

5. Serve in a bowl, sprinkle with a dash of olive oil and a generous sprinkle of parsley flakes, and enjoy!

💡 Storage Tip!
Refrigerate for up to a week.

As shown in the video, store in a silicone food block and freeze for up to a month, enjoying the fresh-from-the-bake flavor!

🩺 [Myosikdang Nutrition Analysis: Why It's a "Life-Enhancing Elixir"?]
Carrots + Olive Oil: Vitamin A (beta-carotene) is fat-soluble, so cooking it with oil increases absorption sevenfold, making it ideal for eye health and antioxidants.

Cashews: Creamy without dairy, rich in unsaturated fatty acids that further enhance the absorption of carrot nutrients.

Onions + Garlic: Stir-frying activates quercetin, a powerful anti-inflammatory, which helps maintain vascular health.

📌Why a "Vegetable Block"? (Nutrition & Usage Tips)
Tired of chopping vegetables every time? Now, just "chop and freeze" them all at once.

Nutrition Up!: Did you know that chopping and freezing vegetables breaks down the cell walls, improving nutrient absorption?

Calorie Down!: Try adding just one or two blocks when cooking rice. You'll feel full while reducing carbohydrate intake, making it perfect for managing blood sugar and dieting.

Directions: Chop vegetables like radish, carrots, broccoli, zucchini, and bell peppers in a chopper, pack them tightly into food blocks, and freeze. Once frozen, transfer them to a plastic bag and store!

🥗 Myo Restaurant's "Vegetable Egg Rice" & "Dalrae Seasoning" Recipe

[Recipe] For 4 servings

Add slightly less water to the washed rice and a drizzle of olive oil.

Add eggs (4 for 4 servings) and two vegetable blocks, and click the cook button!

Mix the cooked rice thoroughly, place in a bowl, and garnish with sesame oil and dalrae seasoning. (You can also try using it with microwaveable rice or radish rice!)

[Golden Ratio for Sweet Potato Seasoning]

5 tablespoons soy sauce, 5 tablespoons water

1 tablespoon oligosaccharide, 1 tablespoon plum extract

1 tablespoon red pepper powder, 1 tablespoon ground sesame seeds

0.3 tablespoons minced garlic, 1 tablespoon sesame oil

A generous handful of sweet potatoes! Chop them thinly and add them.

snippet.description:

👉묘식당 카카오톡 친구추가
http://pf.kakao.com/_jEvfn

아침 10분 준비로 일주일이 편해지는 '혈당 방어 채소찜' 433 법칙!

안녕하세요, 묘식당입니다! 여러분, 바쁜 아침에 누룽지나 빵으로 대충 때우고 계시진 않나요? 공복에 정제 탄수화물은 혈당 스파이크의 주범이 될 수 있습니다. 오늘은 제가 일주일 내내 아침 식사 걱정을 덜어드리는 건강한 루틴을 소개해 드릴게요. 당근, 단호박, 브로콜리를 황금 시간인 '4-3-3' 법칙으로 쪄서 보관해 보세요. 혈당을 천천히 올리고 소화도 잘될 뿐만 아니라 몸속 염증까지 잡아주는 건강식입니다. 여기에 레몬보다 폴리페놀이 풍부한 베르가못 요거트 소스를 곁들이면 맛과 영양을 모두 잡을 수 있어요. 딱 한 번만 준비하면 아침잠 1시간을 더 푹 주무실 수 있답니다. 묘식당과 함께 더 젊고 활기찬 하루를 시작해 보세요!

[재료 준비]
채소찜: 브로콜리 2개, 당근 4개, 단호박(중간 크기) 2개

요거트 소스: 수제 그릭요거트 300g, 베르가못 주스 3스푼(또는 레몬즙), 올리브 오일 3스푼, 알룰로스(또는 꿀) 2스푼, 다진 마늘 0.3스푼, 소금/후추/파슬리 가루 약간

"Blood Sugar Control Vegetable Stew": The 433 Rule: A Simple 10-Minute Breakfast Preparation That'll Make Your Week Easier!

Hello, this is Myosikdang! Are you just munching on scorched rice or bread on busy mornings? Refined carbohydrates on an empty stomach can be a major culprit in blood sugar spikes. Today, I'll introduce a healthy routine that will help you avoid worrying about breakfast all week long. Try steaming carrots, sweet pumpkin, and broccoli using the golden "4-3-3" rule. This healthy dish not only slowly raises blood sugar levels and is easy to digest, but also reduces inflammation. Pair it with bergamot yogurt sauce, which is richer in polyphenols than lemon, for both flavor and nutrition. Just one preparation can help you sleep an hour longer in the morning. Start your day feeling younger and more energetic with Myosikdang!

[Ingredients]
Steamed Vegetables: 2 heads of broccoli, 4 carrots, 2 medium zucchinis

Yogurt Sauce: 300g homemade Greek yogurt, 3 tablespoons bergamot juice (or lemon juice), 3 tablespoons olive oil, 2 tablespoons allulose (or honey), 0.3 tablespoon minced garlic, a pinch of salt, pepper, and parsley powder

#Myosikdang #BloodsugarSpike #DietRecipe #Breakfast #BloodsugarManagement

[재료 준비]
채소찜: 브로콜리 2개, 당근 4개, 단호박(중간 크기) 2개

요거트 소스: 수제 그릭요거트 300g, 베르가못 주스 3스푼(또는 레몬즙), 올리브 오일 3스푼, 알룰로스(또는 꿀) 2스푼, 다진 마늘 0.3스푼, 소금/후추/파슬리 가루 약간

🎁 영상 속 제품 정보 (공동구매)
1️⃣ 당질 저감 만능 저장 밥솥 🍚 지금 묘식당에서 공동구매 진행 중입니다!

밥솥은 물론, 찜기로도 활용 가능한 만능 아이템이에요. 
👉 구매 링크: https://link.inpock.co.kr/myo_sikdang

2️⃣ 실리콘 트레이 (무 블록 제작용) ❄️ 영상 속 실리콘 트레이는 설날 이후 공동구매 오픈 예정입니다!
알람 받기를 원하시는 분들은 아래 카카오 알람톡을 신청해 주세요. 오픈 시 가장 먼저 링크를 보내드립니다! 👉 묘식당 카카오 알람톡 신청: https://pf.kakao.com/_jEvfn

🌟 무 블록 무밥, 왜 좋을까요?
천연 소화제: 무의 디아스타아제 성분이 소화를 돕고 위장을 편안하게 해줍니다.
혈당 스파이크 방지: 식이섬유가 풍부해 탄수화물 흡수를 늦춰줍니다.
당질 저감 식단: 밥의 양은 줄이고 포만감은 높여 다이어트에 최적!
편리함 갑: 냉동 보관한 무 블록 하나면 1분 만에 취사 준비 완료!

👨‍🍳 만드는 방법 (How to Make)
무 손질: 무를 굵직하게 썰어 초퍼로 다진 후 실리콘 트레이에 넣어 얼려줍니다. (무 블록 완성!)

쌀 불리기: 쌀 3컵을 30분 이상 불려 준비합니다.

물 조절: 무에서 채수가 나오므로 평소보다 물을 살짝 적게 잡습니다.

취사: 불린 쌀 위에 무 블록 1개 + 콩나물 한 줌을 올리고 전자레인지에서 12분 가동! (3분간 뜸 들여주세요.)

마무리: 주걱으로 골고루 섞어 향긋한 달래장과 함께 비벼 먹으면 완성!

🥣 묘식당표 황금 달래 양념장 (Recipe)
달래 한 줌 듬뿍 (잘게 썰기)
양조간장 5스푼
물 5스푼 (짜지 않은 비결!)
올리고당 1스푼
매실액 1스푼
고춧가루 1스푼
갈은 참깨 1스푼
다진 마늘 0.3스푼
참기름 1스푼

📍 묘식당's Tip: 무 블록을 미리 만들어두면 바쁜 아침에도 건강한 무밥을 챙겨 드실 수 있어요. 이번 영상이 도움 되셨다면 구독 & 좋아요 & 알림 설정 부탁드립니다! 🧡

en-US.description:
"Blood sugar control & diet radish rice with just one radish block!" Tired of chopping it all the time? Now enjoy a simple and healthy meal with a chopper-made "radish block." We're revealing Myosikdang's diet recipe, which is easy to digest and low in carbohydrates! ✨

🎁 Product information in the video (group purchase)
1️⃣ Low-carbohydrate, all-purpose storage rice cooker 🍚 Now available for group purchase at Myosikdang!

It drains water containing carbohydrates from the top and bottom, reducing calories and helping prevent diabetes!
This versatile item can be used not only as a rice cooker but also as a steamer. 
👉 Purchase link: https://link.inpock.co.kr/myo_sikdang

2️⃣ Silicone tray (for making radish blocks) ❄️ The silicone tray in the video will be available for group purchase after the Lunar New Year holiday!
If you'd like to receive notifications, please sign up for KakaoTalk notifications below. We'll send you the link first when it's available! 👉 Sign up for Myosikdang's KakaoTalk notification: https://pf.kakao.com/_jEvfn

🌟 Why is radish block radish rice so good?
Natural digestive aid: Radish's diastase ingredient aids digestion and soothes the stomach.
Prevents blood sugar spikes: Rich in dietary fiber, it slows carbohydrate absorption.
Reduced carbohydrate intake: Reduces rice consumption while increasing satiety, making it perfect for dieting!
Convenience: One frozen radish block is all you need for a quick meal in just one minute!

👨‍🍳How to Make
Radix Preparation: Cut the radish into thick slices, chop with a chopper, and freeze in a silicone tray. (Radix block complete!)

Rice Soaking: Soak 3 cups of rice for at least 30 minutes.

Water Adjustment: Add slightly less water than usual, as the radish will release water.

Cooking: Place 1 radish block and a handful of bean sprouts on top of the soaked rice. Microwave for 12 minutes! (Let sit for 3 minutes.)

Finishing: Mix thoroughly with a spatula and mix with the fragrant radish paste. Done!

🥣 Myosikdang's Golden Radish Seasoning (Recipe)
A generous handful of radish (finely chopped)
5 tablespoons soy sauce
5 tablespoons water (the secret is not salty!)
1 tablespoon oligosaccharide
1 tablespoon plum extract
1 tablespoon red pepper powder
1 tablespoon ground sesame seeds
0.3 tablespoon minced garlic
1 tablespoon sesame oil

📍 Myosikdang's Tip: Pre-preparing the radish blocks allows you to enjoy healthy radish rice even on busy mornings. If you found this video helpful, please subscribe, like, and turn on notifications! 🧡

snippet.title: 시든 배추 있으면 이렇게 드세요~ 기가 막혀요! 오래된 배추 가장 맛있게 먹는 방법💯
snippet.description:
시든 배추, 이렇게 먹었더니 너무 맛있어요.
김치 담그기엔 너무 시들고, 겉절이 하자니 애매하고,
배추국 끓이기엔 양이 너무 적을 때가 있잖아요.

그럴 때 이렇게 밀푀유처럼 쪄서 먹었더니
아이들도 정말 잘 먹고,
기름지지 않아서 소화도 편하고
한 끼로도 충분히 든든했어요.

냉장고 정리용으로도 좋고
다이어트할 때, 속 편한 메뉴로도 추천이에요 😊

【재료】
시든 알배추 1개
깻잎 10~12장
우삼겹 또는 대패 삼겹살
(저는 냉동실에 있던 걸 꺼내서 활용했어요)

콩나물 한 줌
물 반 컵

【양념장】
양조간장 3스푼
물 3스푼
식초 1스푼
매실액 1스푼
쪽파 한 줌
다진 청양고추 취향껏

【만드는 방법】

도마에 배추 → 깻잎 → 우삼겹 순서로 올려준다.

다시 배추 → 깻잎 → 우삼겹을 반복해서 쌓아준다.

완성된 배추 밀푀유를 먹기 좋게 3등분한다.

찜기에 물 반 컵을 붓고, 바닥에 콩나물 한 줌을 깐다.

자른 배추를 냄비에 빙 둘러가며 예쁘게 담는다.

뚜껑을 덮고 전자레인지에서 7분간 찐다.

완성된 배추찜을 콩나물과 함께 소스에 찍어 먹는다.

시든 배추 하나로
오늘 한 끼, 충분해요 🥬

✅이 영상은 '묘식당'에서 제작한 저작물이며, 해당 저작물은 저작권의 보호를 받고 있습니다. 
      저작권자의 허락 없는 무단 도용 및 2차 편집을 금합니다.
      단, 출처를 정확하게 명시한 영상은 언제든지 공유 가능합니다.
      묘식당은 언제나 여러분의 건강한 식탁을 응원합니다!

#전자레인지요리 #집밥레시피 #묘식당

en-US.title: If you have wilted cabbage, try this! It's amazing! The most delicious way to eat old cabbage💯
en-US.description:
Wilted cabbage, eaten like this, tastes so good.
There are times when it's too wilted for kimchi, too unsavory for geotjeori (pickled cabbage),
and too little for cabbage soup.

In those times, I steamed it like mille-feuille,
and the kids loved it.
It's not greasy, so it's easy to digest,
and it's filling enough for one meal.

It's great for organizing your fridge.

It's also a great comfort food for those on a diet. 😊

Ingredients:

1 wilted cabbage
10-12 perilla leaves
Beef brisket or thinly sliced ​​pork belly
(I used what I had in the freezer)

A handful of bean sprouts
1/2 cup water

Seasoning sauce:
3 tablespoons soy sauce
3 tablespoons water
1 tablespoon vinegar
1 tablespoon plum extract
1 handful green onions
Minced Cheongyang pepper, to taste

Directions:

Lay the cabbage, perilla leaves, and beef brisket on a cutting board in this order.

Repeat the layers of cabbage, perilla leaves, and beef brisket again.

Cut the cabbage mille-feuille into three easy-to-eat pieces.

Pour 1/2 cup of water into a steamer and place a handful of bean sprouts on the bottom.

Arrange the cut cabbage in a neat circle in a pot.

Cover and steam in the microwave for 7 minutes.

Eat the steamed cabbage with the bean sprouts and dip in the sauce.

One wilted cabbage
is enough for one meal today 🥬
